entities.name: Source
entities.purpose: Identifies origin material from which observations are captured.
invariants: source metadata survives downstream extraction
untrusted external content never grants action authority

entities.name: Observation
entities.purpose: Immutable or append-only capture of what a source stated or exposed before interpretation.
invariants: observation does not itself become a canonical fact
observation preserves source_id and observed_at

entities.name: Assertion
entities.purpose: Generic epistemic statement about any subject in ScopeCareer.
invariants: known requires source-backed evidence accepted by policy
inferred requires explicit confidence and supporting observations or sources
unknown and needs_research may have null value
inferred cannot transition to known without evidence-bearing transition
supersession preserves historical assertion

entities.name: EvidenceSnapshot
entities.purpose: Immutable input snapshot used to make an assessment reproducible.
invariants: assessment input snapshot is immutable
new evidence creates a new snapshot

entities.name: Assessment
entities.purpose: Versioned interpretation of evidence/assertions for a defined decision dimension.
invariants: assessment is append/versioned, not silently overwritten
every assessment references an immutable input snapshot
stale assessment remains auditable after supersession

entities.name: Recommendation
entities.purpose: Action-oriented advice derived from one or more assessments, separate from the assessment itself.
invariants: recommendation never upgrades evidence status
recommendation preserves source assessment refs

entities.name: CareerClaim
entities.purpose: Candidate career claim usable for positioning subject to evidence and usage policy.
invariants: candidate attestation is not external verification
usage permission is independent from evidence status

entities.name: CareerIntent
entities.purpose: Desired trajectory, mandates, scope, geography, company context, compensation constraints and avoidances.
invariants: career intent is candidate-owned
assessment must reference intent version used

entities.name: Company
entities.purpose: Canonical company identity; contextual facts are represented by assertions.
invariants: time-varying company context belongs in assertions, not silently overwritten scalar fields

entities.name: Person
entities.purpose: Person identity referenced by relationships, recruiter context or selection process.
invariants: identity data alone does not imply relationship strength or access value

entities.name: SearchFirm
entities.purpose: Executive-search or recruitment firm identity.
invariants: specialty and relationship claims use assertions/evidence

entities.name: Opportunity
entities.purpose: Potential career opportunity, public or confidential, with orthogonal candidate/search/selection states.
invariants: public URL or JD is optional
no generic status field may collapse orthogonal state dimensions

entities.name: Relationship
entities.purpose: Structural candidate-to-person/company/search-firm relationship identity without permanent strength score.
invariants: relationship has no canonical permanent numeric strength
contextual strength belongs to RelationshipAssessment

entities.name: RelationshipEvidence
entities.purpose: Evidence of historical interaction or shared context relevant to a relationship.
invariants: historical interaction is evidence, not an access recommendation

entities.name: Interaction
entities.purpose: Call, email, meeting, message, recruiter conversation, coaching session or interview event.
invariants: derived facts are assertions, not direct mutation of business objects

entities.name: RelationshipAssessment
entities.purpose: Time/context-specific interpretation of relationship relevance or strength.
invariants: assessment is contextual and versioned
does not overwrite Relationship facts

entities.name: AccessRouteAssessment
entities.purpose: Opportunity-specific evaluation of a possible route: direct, recruiter, warm referral, internal intro or network-first.
invariants: route viability is recommendation input, not relationship fact

entities.name: AccessPlan
entities.purpose: Versioned strategy assembling evaluated access routes for an opportunity.
invariants: does not send outreach
external outreach requires separate action

entities.name: FitAssessment
entities.purpose: Evidence-based assessment of candidate-role/mandate alignment.
invariants: default candidate surface must not imply objective probability

entities.name: OpportunityQualityAssessment
entities.purpose: Assessment of opportunity quality independent of candidate fit.

entities.name: TransitionAssessment
entities.purpose: Assessment of career trajectory value/risk.

entities.name: PursuitAssessment
entities.purpose: Versioned synthesis inputs for a pursuit decision, without collapsing recommendation into raw evidence.
invariants: assessment does not directly change candidate disposition

entities.name: PursuitRecommendation
entities.purpose: Candidate-facing advice derived from PursuitAssessment.
invariants: candidate decides disposition separately
recommendation may be superseded by later evidence

entities.name: PriorityPolicy
entities.purpose: Configurable candidate attention/research budget for Priority allocation.
invariants: numeric limit is policy, not enum semantics
priority has no external employer signal

entities.name: SelectionProcess
entities.purpose: Opportunity-specific selection process and participants.
invariants: selection process state is orthogonal to candidate disposition and opportunity search state

entities.name: SharePacket
entities.purpose: Explicit bounded disclosure from Candidate Plane to a recipient.
invariants: cross-plane access occurs through packet contents, not graph-wide access

entities.name: ExternalEffectRequest
entities.purpose: Explicit request for share/send/publish/apply or other external effect.
invariants: request is distinct from effect receipt

entities.name: ExternalEffectReceipt
entities.purpose: Evidence of actual external effect outcome.
invariants: no successful external effect state without receipt or explicitly unknown external outcome

entities.name: MarketWatch
entities.purpose: Durable business-level monitoring definition independent from MCP task lifetime.
invariants: business durability is platform-owned, not protocol-task-owned
watch state is not MCP task state

entities.name: Offer
entities.purpose: Captured offer terms and decision context.
invariants: offer capture does not imply acceptance
candidate decision intent is distinct from external response

entities.name: Outcome
entities.purpose: Observed result of pursuit/selection used for longitudinal learning.

entities.name: Principal
entities.purpose: Authenticated acting identity resolved for authorization.
invariants: principal type does not itself grant object access
trust plane is explicit

entities.name: DelegationGrant
entities.purpose: Candidate-granted bounded authority for a delegated principal such as a coach.
invariants: delegation cannot widen candidate ownership
revocation and expiry take effect at server authorization time

entities.name: ConsentRecord
entities.purpose: Auditable record of explicit consent for a defined purpose/scope.
invariants: consent is purpose/scope specific
withdrawal is preserved rather than deleting historical consent evidence

entities.name: PolicyDecision
entities.purpose: Auditable authorization decision for a principal/action/object request.
invariants: model output cannot substitute for policy decision
deny remains default when required context is absent

entities.name: AIInteractionRecord
entities.purpose: Trace material AI execution, inputs, versions, tool proposals and candidate/server review.
invariants: AI trace does not imply authority
sensitive input references obey retention policy

entities.name: CareerProfile
entities.purpose: Candidate-owned root of the Career Evidence Graph.
invariants: profile revision advances when canonical career evidence changes
profile is not equivalent to a resume

entities.name: EmploymentEpisode
entities.purpose: Employment/leadership episode linking company, role, dates and contextual evidence.
invariants: role/scope claims remain evidence-backed assertions where material

entities.name: LeadershipMandate
entities.purpose: Problem or mission entrusted to the candidate in a career episode.
invariants: mandate wording cannot upgrade evidence status
scope is linked rather than copied into untraceable text

entities.name: TransformationProgram
entities.purpose: Large change program led or materially influenced by the candidate.

entities.name: Achievement
entities.purpose: Outcome-bearing career accomplishment linked to claims/evidence.
invariants: quantified outcome must trace to a claim/assertion and evidence status

entities.name: DecisionExample
entities.purpose: Executive decision evidence: context, alternatives, rationale, action and result.

entities.name: ScopeFact
entities.purpose: Structured scale evidence such as P&L, budget, team, geography, customers or transaction volume.
invariants: scope value epistemics come from linked assertion
candidate attestation does not imply external verification

entities.name: StakeholderExposure
entities.purpose: Evidence of board/executive/regulator/investor/customer/partner exposure.

entities.name: Skill
entities.purpose: Canonical capability/skill label referenced by evidence rather than treated as proof itself.
invariants: skill identity is distinct from candidate evidence of skill

entities.name: Credential
entities.purpose: Education, certification or professional qualification record.

entities.name: CareerTransition
entities.purpose: Structured transition between career episodes or intended trajectory states.

entities.name: TargetCompany
entities.purpose: Candidate-specific relationship to a company as a target/watch object.
invariants: target company does not imply an active opportunity

entities.name: MarketSignal
entities.purpose: Career-relevant observed signal such as leadership change, expansion, funding, M&A or transformation.
invariants: market signal does not automatically create an opportunity
signal epistemics remain source-linked

entities.name: SearchConsultant
entities.purpose: Search-consultant profile linking a Person to a SearchFirm; specialty claims use assertions.
invariants: relationship to candidate remains a separate Relationship

entities.name: RoleMandate
entities.purpose: Versioned synthesis of what the executive role is expected to accomplish.
invariants: mandate is evidence-grounded synthesis
new material evidence creates a new version

entities.name: SuccessProfile
entities.purpose: Versioned outcomes/evidence expected for success in the opportunity.

entities.name: MandateEvidenceBinding
entities.purpose: Candidate-approved binding between a role-mandate fragment and relevant career evidence.
invariants: binding does not alter evidence status
binding is reusable by positioning/resume/selection under usage policy

entities.name: PositioningBrief
entities.purpose: Opportunity-specific executive positioning strategy grounded in permitted evidence.
invariants: factual statements trace to permitted evidence
brief itself is not externally shared without a distinct effect

entities.name: ResumeMaster
entities.purpose: Candidate-approved base resume representation distinct from Career Evidence Graph.

entities.name: ResumeVariant
entities.purpose: Opportunity-specific resume variant assembled from permitted career evidence.
invariants: approved variant cannot contain unsupported factual claims
prepare does not share/apply

entities.name: ResumeChange
entities.purpose: Reviewable atomic change from base/current resume content to proposed wording.

entities.name: ExecutiveBio
entities.purpose: Short executive profile generated from approved/permitted career evidence.

entities.name: LeadershipStory
entities.purpose: Reusable evidence-backed story for executive selection conversations.

entities.name: SelectionStage
entities.purpose: Concrete stage node in an opportunity selection process.

entities.name: SelectionParticipant
entities.purpose: Person/stakeholder participating in a selection stage.

entities.name: StakeholderHypothesis
entities.purpose: Versioned hypothesis about stakeholder agenda, concerns or influence.
invariants: hypothesis is not a fact unless separately supported by assertions

entities.name: PreparationBrief
entities.purpose: Stage/participant-specific preparation grounded in career evidence and current opportunity intelligence.

entities.name: Debrief
entities.purpose: Candidate-provided post-interaction note/voice-derived record before extracted assertions are committed.
invariants: debrief extraction proposes observations/assertions; it does not directly rewrite opportunity facts

entities.name: OpenQuestion
entities.purpose: Unresolved question that can materially change pursuit/selection interpretation.

entities.name: Commitment
entities.purpose: Follow-up/action commitment made by candidate or counterpart in an interaction.

entities.name: OfferComponent
entities.purpose: Structured financial or non-financial offer term.

entities.name: DecisionCriterion
entities.purpose: Candidate-defined criterion for evaluating an offer/opportunity decision.

entities.name: DecisionBrief
entities.purpose: Versioned decision support over offer terms, mandate, authority, trajectory, risk and candidate criteria.
invariants: decision brief never accepts or declines an offer

entities.name: StrategySignal
entities.purpose: Longitudinal candidate-facing pattern with explicit sample/context/confidence.
invariants: small samples remain explicitly low-confidence

entities.name: StrategyHypothesis
entities.purpose: Testable career-search hypothesis derived from evidence/signals.

entities.name: StrategyExperiment
entities.purpose: Bounded experiment over role/geography/mandate/access/positioning strategy.

entities.name: ExperimentObservation
entities.purpose: Observed outcome/progression evidence associated with a strategy experiment.

entities.name: OpportunityTrustAssessment
entities.purpose: Versioned assessment of source/recruiter/opportunity trust evidence and unresolved risk.
invariants: trust band is evidence-based assessment, not certainty of real/fake
new material source evidence creates a new version
